paper_metadata.title: Enhancing tensile strength of Mg–Al–Ca wrought alloys by increasing Ca concentration

evidence.quote: The tensile strengths of the as-extruded Mg – Al – Ca ternary alloys at both ambient and elevated temperatures are enhanced via adding a high content of Ca element up to 6 wt%.
in present Mg-A -Ca alloys with high Ca content, numerous bulk (Mg, Al)2Ca phases are found to distribute among the Mg matrix.
